subject: math.DG
name: Gauss's theorema egregium
statement: The Gaussian curvature of a smooth surface in Euclidean three-space depends only on its induced Riemannian metric. Consequently, local isometries of surfaces preserve Gaussian curvature.

subject: math.DG
name: Gauss–Bonnet theorem
statement: For a closed oriented Riemannian surface M, the integral of its Gaussian curvature K against its area measure equals 2πχ(M), where χ(M) is the Euler characteristic.

subject: math.DG
name: Chern–Gauss–Bonnet theorem
statement: For a closed oriented Riemannian manifold of even dimension, the integral of the Euler form constructed from the curvature of its Levi-Civita connection equals its Euler characteristic.

subject: math.DG
name: Hopf–Rinow theorem
statement: A connected finite-dimensional Riemannian manifold is complete as a metric space if and only if all its geodesics extend for all real times. Under these equivalent conditions, every two points can be joined by a minimizing geodesic and every closed bounded set is compact.

subject: math.DG
name: Cartan–Hadamard theorem
statement: On a complete simply connected Riemannian manifold with nonpositive sectional curvature, the exponential map at any point is a diffeomorphism from its tangent space onto the manifold.

subject: math.DG
name: Bonnet–Myers theorem
statement: If a complete connected n-dimensional Riemannian manifold, n ≥ 2, has Ricci curvature at least (n−1)k times the metric for a constant k > 0, then its diameter is at most π/√k. It is compact and its fundamental group is finite.

subject: math.DG
name: Bishop–Gromov volume comparison
statement: If a complete n-dimensional Riemannian manifold, n ≥ 2, has Ricci curvature at least (n−1)k times the metric, the ratio of the volume of a radius-r ball to that of a radius-r ball in the simply connected constant-curvature-k model is nonincreasing in r. For k > 0, comparison radii are restricted to 0 < r < π/√k.

subject: math.DG
name: Rauch comparison theorem
statement: Let unit-speed geodesics in two Riemannian manifolds have normal Jacobi fields J and J̃ vanishing at time zero with equal initial derivative norms. If every sectional curvature along the first geodesic is no larger than every sectional curvature along the second, then |J(t)| ≥ |J̃(t)| up to the first positive conjugate time along the second geodesic.

subject: math.DG
name: Synge's theorem
statement: A compact connected even-dimensional orientable Riemannian manifold with strictly positive sectional curvature is simply connected. A compact connected odd-dimensional Riemannian manifold with strictly positive sectional curvature is orientable.

subject: math.DG
name: Soul theorem
statement: Every complete connected noncompact Riemannian manifold with nonnegative sectional curvature contains a compact totally convex, totally geodesic submanifold without boundary, called a soul. The manifold is diffeomorphic to the normal bundle of its soul.

subject: math.DG
name: Nash isometric embedding theorem
statement: Every compact smooth Riemannian manifold admits a smooth isometric embedding into some finite-dimensional Euclidean space. The embedding pulls back the Euclidean metric to the prescribed metric.

subject: math.DG
name: Fundamental theorem of hypersurfaces
statement: Let a simply connected smooth n-manifold carry a Riemannian metric g and a symmetric bilinear form h satisfying the Euclidean Gauss and Codazzi equations. There is an isometric immersion into Euclidean (n+1)-space with second fundamental form h, unique up to Euclidean rigid motion after a normal orientation is fixed.

subject: math.DG
name: Frobenius theorem
statement: A smooth constant-rank distribution on a smooth manifold is tangent to a foliation by immersed submanifolds if and only if the Lie bracket of any two smooth vector fields tangent to the distribution is again tangent to it.

subject: math.DG
name: De Rham decomposition theorem
statement: A complete simply connected Riemannian manifold splits isometrically as a product of a Euclidean space and complete simply connected factors with irreducible holonomy. The factors are unique up to order and isometry.

subject: math.DG
name: Hodge theorem
statement: On a closed oriented Riemannian manifold, each real de Rham cohomology class has exactly one harmonic differential-form representative. A form is harmonic when it lies in the kernel of the Hodge Laplacian.

subject: math.DG
name: Bochner vanishing theorem for one-forms
statement: On a closed connected Riemannian manifold with nonnegative Ricci curvature, every harmonic one-form is parallel. If the Ricci curvature is positive definite at some point, the first real Betti number is zero.

subject: math.DG
name: Fundamental theorem of Riemannian geometry
statement: Every smooth Riemannian metric admits exactly one affine connection that is torsion-free and preserves the metric. This connection is the Levi-Civita connection.

subject: math.DG
name: Whitehead convexity theorem
statement: Every point of a smooth Riemannian manifold has a neighborhood in which any two points are joined by a unique minimizing geodesic that stays inside the neighborhood.

subject: math.DG
name: Differentiable sphere theorem
statement: A closed simply connected Riemannian manifold of dimension at least two with strictly pointwise quarter-pinched sectional curvature is diffeomorphic to a sphere. Strict quarter pinching means that at each point all sectional curvatures are positive and the largest is less than four times the smallest.

subject: math.DG
name: Uniformization theorem
statement: Every simply connected Riemann surface is conformally equivalent to exactly one of the Riemann sphere, the complex plane, or the open unit disk.
